title: Paper Claim Matrix

canonical_node.axiom: Claims in the paper are tracked by their formal status; only those marked 'proved' are considered established within the toy model.
definitions: C0 and C1: distinct coupling architectures
CouplingStep: one-way transition from C0 to C1
Q: a parameter in the master equation; Q=0 collapses the equation
Stage sequence: ordered sequence of stages from pre-localization to redistribution
Ten-factor bridge matrix: physical/theological bridge matrix with ten factors
tau_lock: a parameter with conjectured value 33 years
derivation: C0 and C1 are distinct coupling architectures (proved).
C0 -> C1 is irreversible relative to the current one-way CouplingStep.
Q=0 collapses the master equation in the toy model over Nat.
Stage sequence reaches redistribution from pre-localization in the toy model.
Individual reverse stage steps are absent by construction.
The named physics operation sequence maps to the named theology sequence in the toy model.
Law 4 strong-force/love abstraction is isomorphic relative to enriched toy definition.
Ten-factor bridge matrix is internally consistent relative to encoded signatures.
Full ten-factor toy product collapses when any slot is zero in the toy model.
tau_lock = 33 years is a conjecture or open.
Incarnation maps to localization is conceptual.
Crucifixion maps to release/cost payment is conceptual.
Resurrection maps to vacuum confirmation is conceptual.
Pentecost maps to coupling redistribution is empirical/conceptual.
canonical_node.action: Treat only claims marked 'proved' as established within the toy model; treat all others as conjectural or conceptual and do not use them as evidence for physical or theological conclusions.
boundary: Does not assert any claim beyond the toy model.
Does not assert that toy-model proofs imply real-world physics or theology.
Does not assert that 'proved relative to definition' is a full proof.
Does not assert that 'proved in toy model' is a proof over real-valued fields or integrals.
Does not assert that 'proved relative to encoded signatures' is semantic grounding.
test: Check that each claim's status matches the notes in the matrix.
Check that no claim marked 'not proved', 'conjecture', 'conceptual', or 'empirical/conceptual' is treated as proved.
Check that toy-model proofs are not cited as full proofs.

dg1_dependencies: Definitions of C0, C1, CouplingStep, Q, stage sequence, Law 4, bridge matrix, tau_lock
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a status matrix for claims, distinguishing proved, assumed, empirical, and conceptual claims.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the distinction between formal proofs and conjectures, preventing overstatement.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this matrix, the paper's claims could be conflated, leading to overstatement of unproved claims.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Record as a status matrix; do not treat as a physics or theology proof.

overstatement_risks: Treating 'proved relative to definition' as full proof
Treating 'proved in toy model' as proof over real-valued fields
Treating 'proved relative to encoded signatures' as semantic grounding
kill_conditions: If any claim marked 'not proved' is used as a premise for a physical conclusion
If toy-model proofs are cited as evidence for real-world phenomena
risk.lean_target: Formalize the toy model and the proofs mentioned; do not attempt to formalize conceptual claims.

plain_summary: This document is a claim matrix that tracks the formal status of various claims in a paper. It explicitly marks which claims are proved in a toy model, which are relative to definitions, and which are conceptual or conjectural. The canonical action is to respect these statuses and not overstate the strength of the claims.
